verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a sandbox that mirrors production with test data. It includes a dedicated pay-in simulation endpoint (POST /payment/v2/payins/simulation) and a 'consistent simulation experience' for pay-ins and payouts, which covers rehearsing payments and payouts without real funds. Missing for 10: sandbox coverage of currency conversions (Transfers v3/quotes), documented deterministic test values or magic amounts that trigger specific outcomes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rehearse everything without real funds — a documented sandbox or testnet mode covering payments, payouts, and conversions with test values that behave deterministically

citations.quote: The sandbox environment provides a consistent simulation experience for pay-ins and payouts across all customer accounts.
To simulate pay-ins with different currencies and payment methods, in the sandbox environment, send the [`POST /payment/v2/payins/simulation`]
The sandbox environment mirrors production but operates with test data, allowing you to build and validate your integration without financial risk.
Use the sandbox environment to test your integration safely before going live.
